candidates.snippet: Ukraine is creating a satellite system similar to Starlink, called Similar, Zelensky says.

The crew of the Tu-95MS that crashed in Amur region on September 29 included two lieutenant colonels and two majors, all 8 aboard died. At least three were senior officers involved in organizing and ordering missile strikes on densely populated cities and civilian infrastructure.
